segments.text: Let's talk about the part of being on a GLP-1 that no one's talking about.
Being on a GLP-1 was amazing until the side effects kicked in.
I started feeling bloated, heavy, and mentally foggy.
And honestly, I just thought it was part of the process.
GLP-1s can slow digestion and impact your gut in ways that leave you feeling off.
So that's when I found SoWell's fiber.
It's not just about regularity, though it helped there too.
It also supports blood sugar levels, heart health, mental clarity, and even immunity.
I literally thought that fiber was so boring until I found out that it is one of the most important parts about being on a GLP-1 journey.
Plus, this tastes like I'm drinking an apple pie.
Since adding it to my routine, I feel lighter, the bloating is gone, and my energy is way up.
Add SoWell fiber to your GLP-1 routine and thank yourself later.

It also supports blood sugar levels, heart health, mental clarity, and even immunity.
